scientific_integrity: Exact analytic proof with fully specified random sampling and asymptotic quantifiers; standalone symbolic, geometric and Monte Carlo checks are corroboration, not independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Exactly three independent isotropic great circles on S^2; near-balanced area spread only; high-order remainder analytic but no full range law. Published-priority assessment provisional; no independent mathematical audit. The classical arcsine normal-area identity is not claimed as original.
title: The seventh-order area-balance law for three random great circles
